sum_insured_options: 5 lakhs and above (exact options not specified in wording; tables reference 5L, 10L, 15L, 25L bands)

room_rent.display: 2% of SI/day or Single Standard AC Room (SI ≥10L); 1.5%/1.25% of SI/day for SI <10L (Class A/other cities)
room_rent.note: For SI ≥10L: 2% of SI per day or Single Standard AC Room, whichever is less. For SI <10L: Class A cities 1.5% of SI/day; other cities 1.25% of SI/day. Service charges capped at 0.5% of SI per hospitalisation.

icu.display: 3% of SI/day (SI ≥10L); 2.5%/2% of SI/day for SI <10L (Class A/other cities)
icu.note: For SI ≥10L: 3% of SI per day or actual, whichever is less. For SI <10L: Class A cities 2.5%; other cities 2% of SI per day.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment. Voluntary co-pay options of 10%, 20% or 25% available at policyholder's choice; once opted cannot be removed during policy period.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, ENT, Hernia, Hysterectomy, Piles, Knee Ligament, Joint Replacement, PIVD capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹50k-₹1L/eye by SI band; ENT disorders: 10% of basic SI up to ₹1.5L; Hernia: 10% up to ₹1.5L/site; Hysterectomy: 10% up to ₹2L; Piles/Fissure/Fistula: 10% up to ₹1.5L; Knee Ligament: 10% up to ₹2L; Joint Replacement: 20% up to ₹3L/replacement; PIVD/spinal: 20% up to ₹3L. Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI.

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability/migration norms.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12-month wait: Tonsillitis/Adenoids surgery, Tympanoplasty/Septoplasty, Fistula/Piles, Carcinoma/Sarcoma, Varicose Veins, Ligament/Meniscus tears. 24-month wait: Cataract, BPH, Hernia, Hydrocele, Sinusitis, Gallstones, PIVD/Spondylitis, Knee/Joint Replacement, Chronic Renal Failure, Benign growths/Cysts, Uterine Fibroids, Hysterectomy.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. Gender Reassignment Surgery is covered as an additional benefit (24-month wait, up to 50% of basic SI max ₹4L).

cumulative_bonus.note: 25% of basic SI after first claim-free year, then 10% per subsequent claim-free year, max 100% of basic SI. Reduces at accrual rate on claim. Alternatively, policyholder may opt for 5% No Claim Discount on premium instead.

restoration.note: 100% of basic SI reinstated once per policy year after exhaustion. Not available for relapses within 45 days, domiciliary/home care, or for 11 listed critical/chronic conditions (cancer, CABG, stroke, etc.). Reinstated SI cannot be used for the same claim that triggered reinstatement.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses for same condition, within SI limit.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses for same condition, within SI limit.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (380 listed in Annexure C)
day_care.note: Extensive list of 380 day-care procedures covered. Also covers hospitalisation >12 hours but <24 hours at insurer's discretion with prior authorisation.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI for medically necessary cases. Excluded for 13 specific conditions including asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, critical illnesses, etc.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation in AYUSH hospitals or day care centres covered including pre/post hospitalisation expenses.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered subject to insured's applicable sub-limits and SI. Donor room rent limited to 50% of insured's room rent entitlement. Ambulance, pre/post hospitalisation and daily allowance not payable for donor.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; within policy SI limit. Payable only on admissible hospitalisation claim.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatment procedures covered (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, deep brain stimulation, etc.) up to 50% of SI per policy period.

consumables.note: Available as paid optional extension. Covers a defined list of consumables (gloves, crepe bandage, diaper, splint, knee braces, etc.); several items remain non-payable even under extension. Once opted, cannot be removed at renewal.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to India only. Emergency Assistance Services available within India (150+ km from home) only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim or policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for renewal and non-monthly installment modes; 15 days for monthly installment mode. Coverage available during grace period only for installment-mode policies.

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only, not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to same product with other insurers allowed with continuity of waiting periods and accrued bonus, subject to IRDAI norms.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, dental (OPD), spectacles/hearing aids, OPD procedures converted to IP, intra-articular injections, physiotherapy (standalone), adventure sports (non-professional), 90-day wait for diabetes/hypertension aggravated diseases

optional_riders.display: Consumable Cover extension; Voluntary Co-payment (10%/20%/25%); No Claim Discount (5% premium discount) as alternative to Cumulative Bonus

insurer: IFFCO TOKIO General Insurance Company Limited
